description: Add per-run Nansen usage logging to each trader. userStories.title: Add nansen_usage_log.jsonl to Base Trader run_pipeline.py
userStories.description:
Current state: Base Trader run_pipeline.py calls get_credits_remaining() before and after the main loop. credits_before and credits_after are used to calculate credits_used. tokens_scanned is tracked as len(results). The run_log.jsonl records duration and tokens_scanned.

What to add to Base Trader run_pipeline.py:

1. Define USAGE_LOG = DATA_DIR / 'nansen_usage_log.jsonl'

2. At the end of main() (after credits_used is calculated), append this entry to nansen_usage_log.jsonl:
{
    'date': datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
    'run_id': run_id,
    'ts': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'tokens_scanned_nansen': len(results),
    'credits_used': credits_used,
    'run_duration_s': round(duration_s, 2)
}

3. Import datetime and timezone if not already imported (datetime is already imported at top of file)

4. Do NOT modify the existing credit_tracker.py -- only add logging to run_pipeline.py

Log format example:
{"date": "2026-03-24", "run_id": "abc123", "ts": "2026-03-24T15:56:12Z", "tokens_scanned_nansen": 47, "credits_used": 47, "run_duration_s": 12.3}

Constraints:
- Append only (do not rewrite the file)
- Use JSON Lines format (one JSON object per line, no trailing comma)
- If the file does not exist, create it automatically
- Do NOT change existing credit tracking logic

userStories.title: Create shared nansen_usage_report.py for monthly and annual summaries
userStories.description:
What to build: create a new script at shared/scripts/nansen_usage_report.py

This script reads all nansen_usage_log.jsonl files across traders and produces a usage summary report.

Log file locations to read:
- businesses/horizen-zkverify/base-trader/data/nansen_usage_log.jsonl
- businesses/horizen-zkverify/solana-trader/data/nansen_usage_log.jsonl
- businesses/personal/hyperliquid-trader/data/nansen_usage_log.jsonl

Command line usage:
  python3 shared/scripts/nansen_usage_report.py [monthly|annual] [YYYY-MM|YYYY]

Behavior:
- If called with 'monthly YYYY-MM': show per-trader summary for that month
- If called with 'annual YYYY': show per-trader summary for that year
- If called with no args: show year-to-date summary

Output format (text):
=== Nansen Usage Report ===
Trader: base-trader
  Month: 2026-03 | Runs: 144 | Tokens Scanned: 6768 | Credits Used: 6768
  Year:  2026    | Runs: XXX | Tokens Scanned: XXXXX | Credits Used: XXXXX

Trader: solana-trader
  ...same...

Total across all traders:
  Month: 2026-03 | Runs: XXX | Tokens Scanned: XXXXX | Credits Used: XXXXX

Implementation:
- Use argparse for CLI
- Read each log file, parse JSON Lines
- Filter by date prefix (YYYY-MM for monthly, YYYY for annual)
- Sum tokens_scanned_nansen, count runs, sum credits_used
- Print formatted table

Constraints:
- Do NOT modify any trader code
- Create the shared/scripts directory if it does not exist
- Handle missing log files gracefully (skip with a warning)
